title: Inventory, Procurement, Supply & Asset Continuity Agents
objective: Build one governed Worker→Specialist→Manager→Orchestrator resource-continuity workforce covering inventory integrity, replenishment/procurement, critical supply continuity and asset/equipment lifecycle without duplicating Field, Finance or Service Delivery ownership.

subgoals.title: Define the canonical Inventory, Procurement, Supply & Asset Continuity workforce, pain boundaries and cross-domain collaboration without duplicating Field, Finance or provider-specific agents
subgoals.completion_basis: acceptance gates and complete outcome, not planned pass count

agent_binding_notes: Supply Continuity Manager and Supply Continuity Specialist are reused by immutable agent_id; First-Time-Fix Preparation remains a Field specialist/collaborator and is not re-parented.
Suppliers, marketplaces, catalogues, payment rails, inventory stores and asset registries are tools/state, not separate agent identities.
Finance retains supplier-payment/cash authority; Supply owns procurement operational decisions and order execution within approved financial boundaries.
No Supervisor or fifth Pro identity is created; predictive behaviour is earned within Worker→Specialist→Manager→Orchestrator.

boundary_rules: Supply & Resource Operations owns inventory integrity, routine replenishment/procurement, critical material continuity and asset/equipment lifecycle/readiness.
Field Quality & Readiness owns job diagnostic/readiness outcomes; First-Time-Fix Preparation publishes demand/readiness needs but is not re-parented into Supply.
Finance owns payment execution, cash controls and outgoing-obligation truth; Supply may create/track approved procurement but cannot invent or autonomously pay supplier liabilities.
Scheduling/Service Delivery owns job/capacity allocation; Supply consumes scheduled demand and protects resource availability without reassigning field work.
Suppliers, marketplaces, catalogues, barcodes, warehouses, payment rails, asset registries and maintenance systems are tools/state, not separate agent identities.

agent_goal_rule: This goal owns durable business/domain outcomes and may reuse, extend or create canonical workforce identities subject to non-duplication and outcome-owner tests.
workforce_goal_rule: Agents are permitted only for durable business/operational outcomes with a distinct ownership boundary. Reuse or extend canonical identities before creating new ones.
